To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the role of utilities is changing as the electric grid evolves from one that provides a single commodity, electricity, to one that enables the exchange of many commodities including electricity, heat, water and data.

electric utilities are important actors for the development of low carbon electric megacities, but that their role is changing from being a provider of electricity to an enabler of the electric city, which requires new business models and pricing mechanisms.

(1) the role of electric utility companies in the development of low carbon, electric cities is to enable a high level of local, renewable electricity generation; (2) electric utilities need to develop business models that are compatible with this goal and (3) the resilience of the electricity grid is a key challenge for utilities in the electric city.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of electric companies and their business models in the transition to low carbon megacities.
understanding the role of electric utility companies in developing electric cities.
the role of electric utility companies in enabling the transition to the electric city.

utilities have an important role in the transition to the electric city, but the exact nature of that role is highly dependent on the local context of the megacity.
the role of utilities in the development of electric cities is a critical but complex one.
the future of electric utilities in megacities will depend on their role as enablers of distributed energy and as providers of resilient supply.

utilities are key to enabling the transition to the electric city, but that the nature of their role will need to be transformed to enable the transition.
utilities have a key role to play in enabling electric cities, but that this role is changing and requires a rethinking of business models and the role of the grid.
the role of utilities in the electric city will change from that of provider of power to enabler of the power system and that the nature of their business models will change accordingly.

electric utilities have a key role to play in the transition to electric cities, but that their business models and governance need to be adapted to this role.
electric utilities can have an important role in developing the low carbon megacity, but the business model for the electric utility must be adapted to the new environment.
the transition to low carbon electric cities requires the development of new business models for utilities, with a key role in the provision of a high level of resilience to power outages.
